question: Which of the following is NOT a town/city on the west coast of India?
solution:
**Gopalpur** is NOT correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Among the options, only **Gopalpur** is NOT a town/city on the west coast of India.
 
• Gopalpur is a city on the** east coast of India.**
 
 
• Gopalpur is a coastal town in **Odisha.**
 
• Gopalpur served as an important port for the seafarers of ancient Kalinga</str
